deployment: PiSensor, the project's full system deployment, with the harness component sysTester and the coverage-dump component

scope: L0: desk-checked; bench confirmation pending (marker `sysTester.MARK(U32)`; event rate at most 5 per second against a 255-byte RFM69 frame).
- UUT: the PiSensor deployment of `docs/ssdd.md` on the Raspberry Pi 5 `soakee`, 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS 13.
- Ground system: fprime-yamcs at the ledger pin, with the project YAMCS configuration directory (CFDP service).
- Prototype configuration (TCP through `fprime-comm-bridge`) for every test except L2-9 and L2-10, which run the flight configuration over the RFM69.
- Out of scope: BMP280 pressure (decision D9); yaw.
entry_gates: - Component campaigns `sensmon`, `picam`, `prodmgr` closed; their unit tests pass.
- Images built from the manifest SHAs; L0-1 and L0-2 pass on the bench.
- Event rate fits the downlink: at most 5 events per second in any window.
- Bench recipe: BMP280, MPU6050, GPS sentence source and Pi Camera attached; bench switches for the BMP280 chip select and the MPU6050 bus; ground Pi with RFM69 for L2-9 and L2-10.
levels: L0 provenance and feasibility · L2 functional · L3 restart · L5 fault paths · L6 negative controls · L7 final state. No L4 endurance test: no requirement has an endurance bound.
not_covered: - delegated: picam — REQ-PiSensor-040 (inspection of the camera library).
- A sensor fault is planted by removing the device from its bus; a device that answers with wrong data is not planted (out-of-range data is waived in the requirements rationale).
- Radio interference and range: the RFM69 link is tested on the bench at short range only.
- The BMP280 and the GPS receiver do not answer on the bench yet; L2-1, L2-2, L5-1, L5-2, L5-5 to L5-10, L5-21, L5-22 cannot run until they are wired.
decision_log: 1. 2026-11-17 designer — deployment = the project's full system deployment plus the harness component `sysTester` (`MARK(U32)`) and the coverage-dump component.

2. 2026-11-17 designer — product content is judged on the ground copy of the file (evidence outside the UUT's own reporting path); `DUMP_SHA256` is a `sysTester` command that hashes the on-board file.
3. 2026-11-17 designer — GPS faults are planted with a bench sentence source on the GPS UART in place of the receiver; the receiver itself is used in L2-1 and L2-2.
4. 2026-11-17 designer — corrupted uplink frames are injected at the ground side of the link by a bench script, not by fprime-yamcs.

tests.title: Image identity
tests.purpose: Proves the running image is the one named in the manifest.
tests.setup: Deployment running on the Raspberry Pi 5; link up.
tests.evidence: Version events equal to the manifest describe strings; board model and OS release in the run record.

tests.title: Marker round-trip
tests.purpose: Proves the marker command round-trips so every later window can be bracketed.
tests.setup: As L0-1.
tests.evidence: Three Marker events in order.

tests.title: Sensor telemetry period
tests.purpose: Proves temperature, attitude and location telemetry each arrive at the ground at least every 2 s.
tests.setup: Deployment running, link up, all four sensors attached and answering.
tests.evidence: Channel strips over 60 s; check: largest gap between ground receipt times of temperature, attitude and location samples <= 2 s.

tests.title: Sensor telemetry period, repeated after commanding
tests.purpose: Proves the 2 s telemetry period holds again after command traffic.
tests.setup: Deployment running, link up, all four sensors attached and answering.
tests.evidence: Channel strips over 30 s; same 2 s gap check; three NoOpReceived events.

tests.title: Capture makes one correlated product
tests.purpose: Proves one capture command makes one product holding a JPEG of at least 640x480 and valid, timed metrics.
tests.setup: Deployment running, link up, all four sensors attached and answering.
tests.evidence: ProductWritten event naming the file; product records read from the downlinked copy in L2-5.

tests.title: Second capture makes a second product
tests.purpose: Proves a later capture makes a new product with its own capture time and fresh metrics.
tests.setup: As L2-3, one product stored.
tests.evidence: Second ProductWritten event with a different name; records read from the downlinked copy in L2-6.

tests.title: Downlink of the first product
tests.purpose: Proves a downlink command delivers the named product by CFDP class 2, byte-identical, to fprime-yamcs.
tests.setup: Product of L2-3 stored.
tests.evidence: CFDP class 2 transaction finished at YAMCS; ground file sha256 equals the on-board sha256 event; product records decoded from the ground file.

tests.title: Downlink of the second product
tests.purpose: Proves a second downlink delivers the second product byte-identical.
tests.setup: Product of L2-4 stored.
tests.evidence: As L2-5 for the second product.

tests.title: Telemetry during a downlink
tests.purpose: Proves sensor telemetry still arrives at least every 10 s while a product is downlinked.
tests.setup: One product stored.
tests.evidence: Channel strips between the CFDP start and finish events; check: largest gap <= 10 s.

tests.title: Telemetry during a second downlink
tests.purpose: Proves the 10 s telemetry bound holds during a repeated downlink of a stored product.
tests.setup: Product of L2-7 stored.
tests.evidence: As L2-7.

tests.title: Flight configuration over the RFM69
tests.purpose: Proves commands, telemetry, events and a CFDP file pass over the RFM69 with no TCP socket open on the Pi.
tests.setup: Flight image running; ground Pi with RFM69 and groundRadio up.
procedure: action: list TCP sockets of the deployment process
tests.evidence: Command response, channel samples, events and file at the ground; socket list empty.

tests.title: Flight configuration, repeated
tests.purpose: Proves the RFM69 path carries a second command, telemetry and file exchange.
tests.setup: As L2-9.
procedure: action: list TCP sockets of the deployment process
tests.evidence: As L2-9.

tests.title: Process restart
tests.purpose: Proves sensor telemetry resumes within 60 s of a process restart without commands and a stored product is still downlinkable.
tests.setup: One product stored.
tests.evidence: Clock restart; first Sensors sample within 60 s with no command before it; ground file sha256 equals the pre-restart sha256.

tests.title: Reboot
tests.purpose: Proves sensor telemetry resumes within 60 s of a reboot without commands and a stored product is still downlinkable.
tests.setup: One product stored.
tests.evidence: As L3-1 after a reboot.

tests.title: BMP280 failure and return
tests.purpose: Proves a failed BMP280 raises WARNING_HI within 10 s, its metric reads invalid, and telemetry resumes within 10 s of its return.
tests.setup: Deployment running, link up, all four sensors attached and answering.
procedure: action: hold the BMP280 chip select inactive (bench switch)
action: release the BMP280 chip select
tests.evidence: sensorMonitor.Bmp280Lost event within 10 s of the action; sensorMonitor.TemperatureValid invalid in F, valid within 10 s in B; no clock restart.

tests.title: BMP280 failure and return, repeated
tests.purpose: Proves the BMP280 loss report and recovery repeat on a second failure.
tests.setup: Deployment running, link up, all four sensors attached and answering.
procedure: action: hold the BMP280 chip select inactive (bench switch)
action: release the BMP280 chip select
tests.evidence: As L5-1.

tests.title: MPU6050 failure and return
tests.purpose: Proves a failed MPU6050 raises WARNING_HI within 10 s, its metric reads invalid, and telemetry resumes within 10 s of its return.
tests.setup: Deployment running, link up, all four sensors attached and answering.
procedure: action: disconnect the MPU6050 from the I2C bus (bench switch)
tests.evidence: sensorMonitor.Mpu6050Lost event within 10 s of the action; sensorMonitor.AttitudeValid invalid in F, valid within 10 s in B; no clock restart.

tests.title: MPU6050 failure and return, repeated
tests.purpose: Proves the MPU6050 loss report and recovery repeat on a second failure.
tests.setup: Deployment running, link up, all four sensors attached and answering.
procedure: action: disconnect the MPU6050 from the I2C bus (bench switch)
tests.evidence: As L5-3.

tests.title: GPS failure and return
tests.purpose: Proves a failed GPS raises WARNING_HI within 10 s, its metric reads invalid, and telemetry resumes within 10 s of its return.
tests.setup: Deployment running, link up, all four sensors attached and answering.
procedure: action: stop the GPS sentence source
action: restart the GPS sentence source
tests.evidence: sensorMonitor.GpsSilent event within 10 s of the action; sensorMonitor.LocationValid invalid in F, valid within 10 s in B; no clock restart.

tests.title: GPS failure and return, repeated
tests.purpose: Proves the GPS loss report and recovery repeat on a second failure.
tests.setup: Deployment running, link up, all four sensors attached and answering.
procedure: action: stop the GPS sentence source
action: restart the GPS sentence source
tests.evidence: As L5-5.

tests.title: GPS without a fix
tests.purpose: Proves a receiver reporting no fix reads fix invalid in telemetry and location invalid in a captured product.
tests.setup: GPS sentence source set to no fix.
procedure: action: GPS source sends no-fix sentences
action: GPS source sends fix sentences
tests.evidence: FixValid channel invalid with no GpsSilent event; location validity record invalid in the ground file.

tests.title: GPS without a fix, repeated
tests.purpose: Proves the no-fix indication repeats and clears when the fix returns.
tests.setup: As L5-7.
procedure: action: GPS source sends no-fix sentences
action: GPS source sends fix sentences
tests.evidence: As L5-7; FixValid valid again at the end.

tests.title: Stale metric at capture
tests.purpose: Proves a metric older than 2 s at capture is marked invalid in the product while the others stay valid.
tests.setup: Deployment running, link up, all four sensors attached and answering.
procedure: action: disconnect the MPU6050 from the I2C bus (bench switch)
tests.evidence: Attitude validity record invalid, temperature and location valid, in the ground file.

tests.title: Stale location at capture
tests.purpose: Proves a location older than 2 s at capture is marked invalid in the product.
tests.setup: Deployment running, link up, all four sensors attached and answering.
procedure: action: stop the GPS sentence source
action: restart the GPS sentence source
tests.evidence: Location validity record invalid, temperature and attitude valid, in the ground file.

tests.title: Camera absent
tests.purpose: Proves a capture with the camera unavailable fails its command with WARNING_HI and leaves no product.
tests.setup: Camera made unavailable to the process.
tests.evidence: CAPTURE completes with error; CaptureFailed WARNING_HI; product count unchanged between the two lists.

tests.title: Camera absent, repeated
tests.purpose: Proves a second failed capture also leaves no product and a later capture succeeds.
tests.evidence: As L5-11, then one ProductWritten event.

tests.title: Storage unavailable
tests.purpose: Proves a capture that cannot store its product fails its command with WARNING_HI and leaves no product.
tests.setup: Product directory made read-only.
procedure: action: make the product directory read-only
action: make the product directory writable
tests.evidence: CAPTURE completes with error; StorageFailed WARNING_HI; product count unchanged.

tests.title: Storage full
tests.purpose: Proves a capture with no free space fails its command with WARNING_HI and leaves no partial file.
tests.setup: Product file system filled by a bench file.
procedure: action: fill the product file system
tests.evidence: As L5-13; directory listing by the bench shows no partial file.

tests.title: CFDP transfer without progress
tests.purpose: Proves a transfer with no progress for 60 s ends with WARNING_HI and the product can be downlinked again intact.
tests.setup: One product stored.
procedure: action: stop the ground CFDP service
action: start the ground CFDP service
tests.evidence: DownlinkStalled WARNING_HI; second transfer finished; ground file sha256 equals the on-board sha256.

tests.title: CFDP transfer cut mid-file
tests.purpose: Proves a transfer cut after it started ends with WARNING_HI and a repeated downlink delivers the product intact.
tests.setup: One product stored.
procedure: wait first file data at the ground

tests.title: Link outage
tests.purpose: Proves commanding and telemetry resume within 10 s of the end of a 60 s link outage, without a restart.
tests.setup: One product stored.
tests.evidence: Telemetry gap of at least 60 s; first sample and NO_OP response within 10 s of the unblock action; no clock restart; file delivered.

tests.title: Link outage, repeated
tests.purpose: Proves recovery from a second 60 s link outage.
tests.evidence: As L5-17 without the file.

tests.title: Ground-system outage
tests.purpose: Proves commanding and telemetry resume within 10 s of the ground system's return after 60 s, without a restart of the flight software.
tests.setup: One product stored.
tests.evidence: As L5-17 with the ground system stopped; flight clock does not restart.

tests.title: Ground-system outage, repeated
tests.purpose: Proves recovery from a second ground-system outage.
tests.evidence: As L5-19 without the file.

tests.title: NMEA sentence with a bad checksum
tests.purpose: Proves a sentence with a bad checksum and a new position is discarded and the next good sentence is used.
tests.setup: GPS sentence source under bench control.
procedure: action: GPS source sends position A
action: GPS source sends position B with a bad checksum
action: GPS source sends position C
tests.evidence: Latitude strip shows A then C, never B.

tests.title: NMEA sentences with bad checksums, burst
tests.purpose: Proves a burst of bad-checksum sentences leaves the reported position unchanged.
procedure: action: GPS source sends position A
action: GPS source sends 10 sentences of position B with bad checksums
tests.evidence: Latitude strip stays at A.

tests.title: Corrupted uplink frame
tests.purpose: Proves an uplink frame that fails its integrity check dispatches no command and the same frame uncorrupted does.
tests.setup: Deployment running, link up, all four sensors attached and answering.
procedure: action: inject a NO_OP frame with one bit flipped
action: inject the same NO_OP frame intact
tests.evidence: Exactly one NoOpReceived event, after the intact frame.

tests.title: Corrupted uplink frames, burst
tests.purpose: Proves several corrupted frames dispatch nothing and commanding still works after them.
tests.setup: Deployment running, link up, all four sensors attached and answering.
procedure: action: inject 5 NO_OP frames with a wrong frame check field
tests.evidence: Exactly one NoOpReceived event, from the planned command.

tests.title: Final state
tests.purpose: Leaves one known product on board whose ground copy and on-board hash an auditor can compare.
tests.setup: Deployment running, link up, all four sensors attached and answering.
tests.evidence: Ground file kept in the record; on-board sha256 event; product list.
